import sys
import itertools

n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

playerA = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
playerB = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

playerA_orig = playerA[:]
playerB_orig = playerB[:]

def max_win_score(a, b):
    total_wins = 0
    for i in range(3):
        counter = (i + 1) % 3
        wins = min(a[i], b[counter])
        a[i] -= wins
        b[counter] -= wins
        total_wins += wins
    return total_wins

def max_loss_score(a, b):
    move_pairs = [[0, 2], [1, 0], [2, 1], [0, 0], [1, 1], [2, 2]]
    all_perms = list(itertools.permutations(move_pairs))
    max_loss = 0
    for perm in all_perms:
        a_copy = a[:]
        b_copy = b[:]
        losses = [0, 0, 0]
        for move in perm:
            loss_amount = min(a_copy[move[0]], b_copy[move[1]])
            a_copy[move[0]] -= loss_amount
            b_copy[move[1]] -= loss_amount
            losses[move[0]] += loss_amount
        total_loss = sum(losses)
        if total_loss > max_loss:
            max_loss = total_loss
    return max_loss

print(n - max_loss_score(playerA_orig, playerB_orig), max_win_score(playerA, playerB))
